notes: REF-BM-02: fetch_metadata only collects title/description; no favicon or preview image ever fetched/stored. REF-BM-06: create_bookmark inserts unconditionally on every POST, no url-dedup/edit-redirect (only /api/import skips existing urls). REF-BM-07: cards render title/description/tags/date but no favicon field exists in schema or UI. REF-BM-10: tags input is a plain comma-separated text field with no datalist/autocomplete. REF-BM-14: '#' is stripped by the \w+ tokenizer and searched as a bare term across all FTS columns (not restricted to the tags column), so it's not true tag-scoped search, just incidental overlap. REF-BM-15: _fts_query reduces the query to bare word* tokens joined with implicit AND; no OR/NOT/parentheses support and no literal-quoting escape. REF-BM-16: quotes are stripped by the \w+ regex, so quoted phrases become separate prefix terms, not an exact-phrase match. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag exists anywhere in the schema or UI (only 'favorite'). REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk action endpoints/UI. REF-BM-22: list is always ordered by created_at DESC; no sort parameter or UI control. REF-BM-23: notes are stored and displayed via esc()+pre-wrap (escaped plain text), not rendered as markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot/HTML-archive or Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive flag or archived-list view exists. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity (saved search+tag filter) exists. REF-BM-31: export only produces JSON via /api/export, no Netscape HTML export. REF-BM-32: no settings entity/UI for default sort, page size, or font size.
